Telangana Government Distributes Sewing Machines to Backward Class Women

The Telangana government has launched a scheme to distribute free sewing machines to women belonging to Backward Classes (BC). The initiative was announced and launched by a Telangana Minister. The scheme aims to provide economic opportunities for women within these communities.
